input.title: User login with email
input.description: As a registered user, I want to log in using my email and password so I can access my meal plans.
input.acceptance_criteria:
1. User must be able to enter email and password.
2. Successful login redirects to dashboard.
3. Invalid credentials show 'Invalid email or password' error.
input.comments: Make sure we lock the account after 5 failed attempts.

expected_behavior: Identify explicit functional requirement for email/password login
Identify business rule for account lockout after 5 attempts

input.title: Fast page loading
input.description: The meal plan generation page should load really fast so users don't get bored.
input.acceptance_criteria:
1. Page loads fast.
2. Shows a spinner while loading.

expected_behavior: Identify ambiguity regarding what 'fast' means (no exact SLA)
Flag missing acceptance criteria around timeout limits

input.title: Export meal plan to PDF
input.description: Users should be able to click a button to download their weekly meal plan as a PDF document.
input.comments: Design says the button should be top right.

expected_behavior: Identify functional requirement for PDF generation
Identify UI dependency based on the comment

input.title: Free tier restrictions
input.description: Free tier users can only generate 3 meal plans per month. They cannot access premium recipes.
input.acceptance_criteria:
1. Free users cannot exceed 5 meal plans per month.
2. Premium recipes are hidden from free users.
input.comments: Wait, is it 3 or 5? We need to ask product.

expected_behavior: Identify conflict between description (3 plans) and AC (5 plans)
Extract premium recipe restriction as a business rule

input.title: Store user dietary health data
input.description: We need to store user allergies and medical dietary restrictions (like diabetes) in their profile.
input.acceptance_criteria:
1. Users can add medical conditions.
2. System saves data to DB.
input.comments: This data falls under HIPAA compliance.

expected_behavior: Identify non-functional requirements around data encryption/privacy
Extract business rule regarding medical condition storage
